name: Guide
description: Represents a drawing guide in the presentation or custom layout.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns the orientation of the drawing guide (horizontal or vertical) as a constant from the PpGuideOrientation enumeration. Read-only.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position of the drawing guide along the x- or y-axis. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns a ColorFormat object that represents the color of the drawing guide. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes the drawing guide from the presentation or custom layout.
